invariants.rationale: After assignment and before return, this.isChecked reflects the value of the isChecked parameter unless modified by fire(changeEvent).
If fireEvent is true, this.isChecked may be reverted by fire(changeEvent), so must be either isChecked or its opposite.
After the method logic, it is impossible for fireEvent to be true and this.isChecked to not equal isChecked or its opposite.
After the fire(changeEvent), this.isChecked is either assigned to isChecked or potentially reverted.
